title: pstack checkpoint: shared mutable state and conflict policy
description:
Document the conflict policy before implementation. The design should make accidental same-file concurrent writes hard to express. The BFF should own active Office sessions and conflict checks. The host should enforce expected revision or idempotency on writes.

## Required Skills
pstack-playbooks,principle-separate-before-serializing-shared-state
design:
This bead is the Feature playbook throughput checkpoint item for shared mutable state.

Shared state includes vault file bytes, document revisions, active Office sessions, callback status, pane state, and agent write targets. The default policy is separation before serialization. Agents write checkpoints or staged copies when a human owns an active dirty editor session.
acceptance_criteria:
[ ] Shared mutable state is enumerated.
[ ] Human edit sessions, Document Server cache keys, agent writes, and vault revisions have an ownership rule.
[ ] Dirty human edits block agent overwrite or force a staged-copy path.
[ ] Document keys include tenant, path, and content revision so cache collisions are impossible.
